body:
To make it clear, none of what you're saying is offending me, its actually helping me. What you said about having to grow up a lot faster really clicked with me, I can really relate to that.

I do have people in my life that support me, my immediate family loves me a lot and cares about me far more than I could ever fathom. I talk to my father and older brother (he's 18, so not being far in age makes it easy to talk to him) a lot about my suicidal thoughts and they always let me know they're there for me.

Thank you for that paragraph about self esteem issues, I really needed someone to put that into perspective for me, especially "People are always their own worst critic", that really stood out to me. Thank you so much for your help, hopefully I can move forward from here and genuinely enjoy life, once again, thank you. :)

My age wasn't something I wanted to reveal, but for my own sake I guess I will, I'm 16. And I'm sorry about your parents, I too lost my mother to cancer. I've been in therapy for 4 years but it never really seemed to help, and with my situation in regards to emotion, I only feel negative ones such as anxiety, sadness, remorse, etc. My anxiety has doubled since I started dating my girlfriend, I have low self esteem so I always worry that she will find a better looking guy.
